signals.title: Recent win: search correctness
signals.body: Tapped formulae are included from live Homebrew search, and loose fuzzy formula matches no longer surface misleading results.

signals.title: Open decision: user-facing output
signals.body: Help shape, script-friendly mode, column presets, and color meaning need to lock before the README should become public-facing.

signals.title: Freshness caveat
signals.body: Tracker and git data refresh live; test count is a recorded verification value, not rerun by the dashboard refresh.

signals.title: Repo hygiene note
signals.body: uv.lock is untracked and intentionally left out until lockfile policy is decided.

notes.title: Product Boundary
notes.body: Read-only query and analytics. No install, uninstall, upgrade, services, Brewfile, TUI, GUI, or multi-package-manager behavior.

notes.title: Current Center
notes.body: Make terminal output trustworthy, compact, explainable, and script-friendly before expanding optional analytics columns.

notes.title: Next Best Move
notes.body: Lock column presets and help text, then turn the README into a public first impression with real output capture.
